## Evidence-tag checklist

- [ ] Every new or changed number is tagged **SYNTHETIC**, **REPORTED**, **TARGET**, or **UNRUN**.
- [ ] **REPORTED** numbers include host, toolchain versions, command, and raw data (or a link).
- [ ] No new claims of real qubit/QPU runs, hardware readiness, medical/therapeutic effect, certification, peer review, or revenue.
- [ ] Simulation output is not described as hardware or clinical evidence.
- [ ] No personal email addresses, phone numbers, secrets, or tokens in code, docs, or commit messages.

## Housekeeping

- [ ] Tests pass locally (and in CI where a workflow exists).
- [ ] README / docs updated if behavior or usage changed.
- [ ] I agree to license this contribution under the repository's license.
